newsitem.title: CHINA: China Eximbank extends aircraft export credit.
newsitem.headline: China Eximbank extends aircraft export credit.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of China on Tuesday granted a 400 million yuan ($48 million) export credit to the Shenyang Aircraft Industrial Group to support sales of aircraft parts to North America, the Xinhua news agency said.
The 10-year loan was the longest extended by the Eximbank since it went into operation in July 1994, the official agency said.
It gave no further details of the credit, but said the Eximbank considered the aviation industry a major target for its loans.
"Since we opened for business, we have approved loans totaling 1.08 billion yuan to finance the export of aircraft and components," Xinhua quoted deputy bank president Qiang Zhongtao as saying.
The bank would give the aviation sector even more support in the future, Qiang said without giving details.
